description: Search for a place to geotag a post. Pass free text (min 2 chars, e.g. a venue name or address); returns matching places, each with an id that works as BOTH controls.facebookPlaceId (Facebook feed posts) and controls.instagramLocationId (Instagram single-media posts). Only Facebook Pages that carry location data are returned.

query.description: Place search text, min 2 characters (e.g. "eiffel tower")

name: search_places
title: Search Places
